description: Spec 037 protocol, bound by experiments/20261123-rmis-decision by SHA-256 and never edited after it. Scoring plans (configs/headroom/rm-val-370.json, rm-test-371.json) are written once the fine-tuned checkpoints exist and must agree with this file.

uses: interval scales (fitted on off and all-central only)
the hybrid's prior weight and fall-back

systems.hybrid: hyb-s1..s3 (C'' segmentation, robust final solve with the fine-tuned regressor as start and prior; settings by addendum after validation)
systems.range_prior_control: c2-prior (the same solve with a static prior on ln range fitted on validation)

statistic: per engagement, the median over its scored rows (rows both sides answer) of the absolute relative range error; the paired ratio numerator / denominator per engagement; geometric mean with a bootstrap over engagements (2,000 resamples, 95%); the three seeds pooled by the mean log ratio within an engagement. Outcome: better (interval wholly above 1), worse (wholly below), not separated.

M5.coverage: stated 95% intervals of the fine-tuned regressors at the validation-fitted scales, per quantity (range, course where stated, speed), on off, all-central and ho-both separately; honest if the engagement-bootstrap interval lies within [0.90, 0.99]
M5.against_temperature: mean interval score (Winkler, 95%) of the head's intervals / the temperature control's, per quantity, pooled over the three conditions; better if the bootstrap interval of the ratio lies wholly below 1

Y1.ties: rows where the hybrid falls back to C''-robust are constructed ties: excluded and counted

readings.harm: Y: any of range, course or speed wholly below 1 for c2-robust / hybrid on off

reported_beside: course and speed: the same paired ratios and efficiency against the bound (the nominal bound under held-out conditions, named so)
median per-engagement ratio, shares better, twice as good, twice as bad
engagement counts; share of rows answered per system
the first bearing an outlier or not (research R8), where the truth file allows
temperature_control: a fixed half-width per quantity and per third of the regressor's own estimated range, fitted on the validation rows of off and all-central to cover 0.95 there; it reads no truth at test
interval_scale: one multiplier of the head's sd per quantity (range, course, speed), fitted on the same validation rows to cover 0.95; the three seeds share it
